title: Work Map Autofix registry refresh scope convergence

phases.objective: Keep the sole governed Work Map writer and its trusted self-hosting bootstrap aligned with the validator when Work Map registry or policy surfaces change, including registry drift that is only discoverable prospectively from the exact-head generator, while preserving bounded write authority, canonical evidence publication, and fail-closed manifest eligibility.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The regression test reads the Spec Kit Work Map Autofix workflow and trusted generated-artifact bootstrap contracts from the exact repository checkout.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Registry-affecting changes and prospective generated Work Map drift expand the writer and trusted bootstrap refresh sets to the same execution-ready Work Map manifests validated by the gate before mutation authority is consumed; ordinary current pull requests remain diff-scoped, invalid manifest states fail closed, and generated evidence accepts only canonical bounded outputs.
steps: Inspect the Work Map Autofix workflow without dispatching it.
Require static registry-refresh expansion to remain conditional on the same Work Map registry or policy change class used by validation.
Require a read-only exact-head generator check before delegation consumption and expand registry refresh scope when that preview reports generated Work Map drift.
Require the generator preview to be structured, secret-free, text-only evidence and reject unexpected execution outcomes before writer authority is consumed.
Require the refresh inventory to include only execution-ready manifests and reject invalid or ambiguous review states.
Require the effective writer set to be the bounded union of target-derived bindings and registry-refresh bindings.
Require the trusted self-hosting bootstrap to discover additional canonical ready manifests dynamically and refresh them through the canonical binding producer.
Require the generated-artifact evidence publisher to accept the same canonical dynamic Work Map output class while rejecting unrelated generated paths.
Require write, staging, currentness, verification, bootstrap, and evidence-publication phases to share compatible bounded authority.

Fail the regression if the writer returns to PR-diff-only scope when its own generator would change the registry, consumes delegation before scope discovery completes, hardcodes future ready manifests, or broadens to arbitrary repository paths.
assertions: Registry-refresh scope expansion is conditional and is not enabled when neither the immutable PR diff nor the read-only generator preview indicates registry drift.
Prospective Work Map generator drift is detected with --check before delegation consumption, so first-cycle generated registry changes cannot leave ready manifests stale.
The prospective generator report is validated as check-mode, secret-free, text-only structured evidence before it can influence scope.
Only canonical execution-ready Work Map integration manifests can enter the registry-refresh or trusted bootstrap dynamic set.
Invalid or unsupported manifest states fail closed before writer authority is consumed.
The writer allowlist accepts only target-derived or registry-refresh bindings that passed bounded classification.

The trusted generated-artifact bootstrap keeps exact-head CAS, protected-branch rejection, deterministic double-pass generation, and canonical producer currentness checks for dynamically discovered ready manifests.
The evidence publisher accepts only canonical Work Map bootstrap outputs and does not authorize arbitrary repository writes.
Write, staging, currentness, verification, trusted bootstrap, and evidence publication share compatible bounded Work Map authority.
No protected-ref mutation, force push, deployment, migration, provider mutation, database write, credential read, or Production mutation is authorized by this contract.

phases.objective: Confirm governed Work Map repair and trusted bootstrap each converge every validator-selected ready manifest in one exact-head writer cycle, including a case where the exact-head generator preview is the only registry-refresh trigger, without scope broadening.
